definitions.explanation: An immensely long stretch of time, reaching far into the past or on without end. Written and literary; almost always used as {悠久|ゆうきゅう}の〜.

examples.japanese: {悠久|ゆうきゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: You can feel the long ages of history.

examples.japanese: {悠久|ゆうきゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{時|とき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{流|なが}れる→流れる：01969_nagareru⟧。

{黄河|こうが}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{悠久|ゆうきゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{人々|ひとびと}→人々：03141_hitobito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{暮|く}らし→暮らし：02670_kurashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{支|ささ}えて→支える：01946_sasaeru⟧きた。
examples.english: The Yellow River has sustained people's lives since time immemorial.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {悠久|ゆうきゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧: a history of countless ages
- {悠久|ゆうきゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大地|だいち}→大地：12187_daichi⟧: the timeless land
- {悠久|ゆうきゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧: since time immemorial

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{永遠|えいえん}→永遠：01873_eien⟧: eternity, the everyday word, usually looking forward
- ⟦{永久|えいきゅう}→永久：01875_eikyuu⟧: permanent, lasting forever
{悠久|ゆうきゅう} adds a sense of grandeur and is used of history and nature.

WATCH OUT:
Do not confuse with ⟦{有給|ゆうきゅう}→有給：04552_yuukyuu⟧ (paid, as in paid leave), which has the same reading.
